site_id.description: REQUIRED. Canonical site the plan is scoped to: a facility-layout Site site_code (the same identifier its SiteCapabilityChanged event publishes). A stated planning fact, never inferred from warehouse_id or location.

location.description: The ProcessCapacity location every path step is looked up under.

window_start.description: Plan window start. A registered capacity window applies when it covers [window_start, window_end).

window_end.description: Plan window end (exclusive); must be after window_start.

assigned_demand.description: OPTIONAL. Orders assigned to the window. When present (even 0) it is used exactly as stated and the plan's demand_source is "request". When omitted it defaults to the orders order-management expects at `location` in the window (GET /demand; demand_source "orders"), or the request is rejected with 422 missing-assigned-demand when there are none -- never silently 0.

units_per_order.description: WorkloadProfile factor (UNIT per ORDER); needed only if a step is measured in UNIT.

packages_per_order.description: WorkloadProfile factor (PACKAGE per ORDER); needed only if a step is measured in PACKAGE.

tasks_per_order.description: OPTIONAL, additive (docs/adr/0022). Tasks per ORDER for a process type, keyed by process type. A step's labour requirement is its tasks x the labor-performance standard seconds of its task type, where tasks = assigned_demand x this factor; a PICK step uses the released order lines instead when the demand came from the order read model (demand_source "orders"). A step without a factor is reported known false with reason no-task-factor, never guessed. Every value must be positive (422 non-positive-tasks-per-order). It never changes path_capacity, the shortage or the bottleneck.

demand_source.description: OPTIONAL (docs/adr/0024). Where assigned_demand comes from. Omitted: "request" when assigned_demand is given, "orders" when it is omitted (the pre-ADR-0024 behaviour). "forecast": the units of the workload forecast of (site_id, forecast_path_id) whose bucket cpt is in [window_start, window_end) (start in, end out), divided by units_per_order and rounded UP to orders. units_per_order is then REQUIRED (422 missing-units-per-order); no bucket in the window is 422 missing-assigned-demand, never zero demand. "orders" and "forecast" derive assigned_demand and refuse a stated one, "request" requires it (422 demand-source-conflict / missing-assigned-demand); any other value is 422 unknown-demand-source.

forecast_path_id.description: OPTIONAL, with demand_source "forecast" only (422 demand-source-conflict otherwise). The process path whose workload forecast is read at site_id -- the path the volume enters (e.g. the wes path PICK), which need not be path_id. Defaults to path_id. Read in its canonical form (trimmed, upper case).

scenario.description: OPTIONAL what-if label (docs/adr/0024), 1 to 64 characters, stored and returned. Several DRAFT plans of one (site_id, path_id, window) are scenarios (see GET /capacity-plans/comparisons). An empty or longer label is 422 invalid-scenario.
